opportunities.name: GitHub user lead research and hiring email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then compose an email to the hiring address with the lead's stats.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username, press Enter
Note followers, repo stars, language and latest post
In mail, click To and enter hiring address
Enter body with followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post

opportunities.name: Person Wikipedia lookup plus Wayback Machine snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, then open an archive.org snapshot of a given site for a given year, and save a combined note.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia and read the summary
Open archive.org Wayback Machine and enter the site URL
Click the target year and pick a snapshot date
Read the headline from the archived page
Return and close the archive overlay
In notes, add a new note combining the person's facts and the archived headline
